mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 7.5%, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or t-test p-value for positive returns exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production growth decelerating below 0.5% signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO growth < 0.5% correlates with positive SPX 20d returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicates strong residential demand, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trend shows positive correlation but SPX 5d returns are negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained annual inflation above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, SPX 60d returns are positive in >50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20d returns in >50% of cases, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, rising FEDFUNDS correlates with positive SPX 20d returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
